features.name: Core Build Pipeline
features.description: Load Markdown content → render HTML → apply templates → write static files to dist/
features.evidence: Build produces 14+ files in dist/ including index.html, post pages, tag/category pages

features.name: PaperMod Theme
features.description: Full PaperMod theme adaptation: dark/light/auto toggle, responsive layout, all 8 template layouts rendering correctly
features.evidence: PaperMod builds successfully, theme toggle JS present, CSS loads correctly

features.name: RSS Feed
features.description: Generate valid RSS 2.0 XML feed at dist/index.xml with latest 20 posts including full content
features.verification: ./blog-forge build && head -3 dist/index.xml | grep -q 'xml version' && grep -q 'rss' dist/index.xml
features.evidence: dist/index.xml generated with RSS 2.0 header, channel info, and item entries

features.name: Sitemap
features.description: Generate valid sitemap.xml with all pages including lastmod timestamps
features.evidence: dist/sitemap.xml generated with urlset, url entries, and loc/lastmod tags

features.name: GitHub Actions Deploy
features.description: CI workflow: push main → Go build → blog-forge build → deploy to gh-pages
features.evidence: .github/workflows/deploy.yml exists with Go setup, build, and peaceiris/actions-gh-pages steps

features.name: Fix nowDate Hardcode
features.description: nowDate() in cmd/blog-forge/main.go is hardcoded to 2026-05-25 instead of using time.Now(). blog-forge new always creates posts with wrong date.
features.verification: grep -q 'time.Now' cmd/blog-forge/main.go && ./blog-forge new test-post && head -3 content/posts/*.md | grep $(date +%Y-%m-%d)

features.name: Extract Shared slugify
features.description: slugify() is duplicated in internal/site/context.go and internal/permalink/permalink.go. Extract to a shared internal/util package.

features.name: Fix RSS atom:link XML
features.description: RSS feed defines AtomLink as a string field which xml.Marshal will XML-escape, producing invalid RSS. Should be a structured XML element with xml:",innerxml" or proper struct.

features.name: Fix parseTime Silent Swallow
features.description: parseTime in internal/content/loader.go silently returns time.Time{} on malformed dates, which becomes time.Now(). Should return an error so the caller can report which file has a bad date.

features.name: Wire TOC Generation
features.description: PostCtx.TOC field exists but is never populated. Wire goldmark-toc extension so posts with headings get a table of contents in the TOC field.

features.name: Wire Theme MergeConfig
features.description: Theme.MergeConfig() method exists but is never called from the build pipeline. User theme overrides in _config.yml under the theme key should override theme.yml defaults.

features.name: Wire serve Command
features.description: internal/serve/ package exists but is not wired into CLI. Add 'serve' subcommand to cmd/blog-forge/main.go that starts local HTTP server on port 8080.

features.name: Add Test Framework + Core Tests
features.description: Zero test files in the project. Add table-driven tests for: permalink.Compute, content.ParseFrontMatter, render.AutoExcerpt, theme.Load, config.Load.

features.name: Populate SiteCtx.Config
features.description: SiteCtx.Config is always nil — never assigned in buildSiteCtx(). Either populate it from _config.yml extras or remove the field if unused.

features.name: Remove Dead Code
features.description: Clean up: IntegrateConf.Wallpaper/PV/Deploy are configured but never used; Post.Weight/Featured/Lang are parsed but never used; internal/serve/ is unreferenced.
